description: A small white lamp base with a round bulb-like top sits near the back of the table, with a separate white cup-shaped shade closer to you. The left hand steadies the lamp base in place while the right hand grasps the cup-shaped shade, lifts it upward and forward, then lowers it onto the top of the base to fit it in place before releasing, leaving the base as the left-hand object and the shade as the right-hand object during placement.
